title: Source event (hint to Signals, SI-03)
description: Webhook from a source service to Signals: new data exists at a position. Identifiers only, no content (SEC-18). Signals reacts by calling <source>.collect through the Hub; it never builds a SourceInboxItem from this body.

event_id.description: Deterministic per source position; receivers dedupe on it

source_ref.description: RID of the source, e.g. telegram:<connection>/chat/<chat_ref>

chat_ref.description: telegram.message.created only: archive chat reference, same as in source_ref

message_id.description: telegram.message.created only: position in the chat

sent_at.description: Time of the source item (Telegram message date), RFC 3339; not the delivery time
